legacy_metadata.limited_reason: Nine independent structural obligations are supported. Additional extensional and cross-file formulations of the same connectivity and flow ownership defects would duplicate GC01-GC07; the empty post stage supplies no further defect.
exclusions: The empty post.diff contributes no independent criterion.
Existing algorithm correctness, compilation, test passage, and preservation of public results are constraints rather than structural score items.
Historical intentions absent from the final patch and the prior four-item rubric were not copied as criteria.
Existing directed/undirected and maximum/minimum-cost variations are covered by the connectivity and flow ownership criteria, so they are not scored again as extensibility items.
